stochasticity_declaration: Results are not claimed to be byte-identically reproducible. GPU kernels, library versions, data-loader ordering, random seeds where recorded, and external environment state can affect replay. Frozen configurations, source commits, manifests, hashes, and dated source/output snapshots are retained to support bounded forensic reproduction.
raw_material_policy: Large raw datasets and model weights are referenced by manifests and hashes when available; they are not duplicated in this archive.
